cv.name: Jasmine Kendrick
cv.headline: Associate Program Manager – Public Health Programs
cv.summary: Program manager with three years coordinating grant-funded public health programs in Georgia. Experienced with federal reporting, partner coordination and keeping multi-site programs on schedule and on budget.

experience.title: Associate Program Manager
bullets: Manage a $2.4M CDC-funded diabetes prevention program across 7 partner clinics
Track milestones, budgets and deliverables and prepare quarterly federal progress reports
Coordinate monthly partner calls and site visits
Program enrollment grew from 380 to 610 participants in one year

experience.title: Program Coordinator
bullets: Maintained participant data in REDCap and supported data quality checks
Organized community outreach events in DeKalb and Clayton counties

experience.title: Program Assistant (AmeriCorps)
bullets: Supported volunteer scheduling for a weekly food distribution serving 900 families

education.school: Emory University, Rollins School of Public Health
